## 1. Who and what

- **Owner:** runs "Fridge Repairs Blacktown" (fridge, freezer and coolroom repair, Blacktown NSW 2148, serving Western Sydney). Not a developer. Writes short Roman Urdu or English messages such as "next page". Wants short, plain, formal English bullets for summaries, one point per page, task name in bold, one line each.
- **Site:** https://fridgerepairblacktown.com.au (custom static HTML plus a small PHP/MySQL blog and admin). The owner asked about moving to WordPress; advice given: do not convert now (ranking depends on content, reviews, Google Business Profile and backlinks, not the CMS). Open question: why they want WordPress (self-editing?).

- **Repo:** `kamran7305-ctrl1/blacktownfridge`. Live branch is **`Main`** (capital M). Merging to `Main` runs GitHub Actions and uploads to Hostinger by FTP.

## 2. Confirmed business facts (use only these)

- Call-out fee **from $69** (covers the visit and diagnosis). Always "from $69", never a flat "$69".
- Warranty **up to 12 months** on parts and labour. Never "1 year".
- Around 30 years of experience. Fully trained and licensed technicians with public liability insurance. Senior discounts. Same-day service where available. Upfront quote; customer approves the price first.
- Emergency service 24 hours, 7 days. The call-out fee stays the same at any hour.
- Services: residential, commercial, emergency, freezer, coolroom, regas and compressor, fault diagnosis.
- Owner confirmed (20 Oct 2026): independent repairer, not a Fisher & Paykel service centre, repairs the F&P ranges listed on that page; camping and 12V fridges; ice machines and ice makers including servicing; walk-in coolrooms and freezer rooms including compressors and condensing units, plus maintenance schedules; regas with both R134a and R600a; commercial brands Skope, Bromic, Williams, Husky, True, Electrolux Professional, Westinghouse. No regas or other price ranges published: pages say "contact us to confirm pricing".
- Contact: booking form (`/#contact-form`, posts to `/send_mail.php`) and info@fridgerepairblacktown.com.au.
- **Not available yet (never invent):** phone number (owner will provide later), street address, ABN, licence number, reviews and ratings, technician names, real job photos, Google Business Profile.
- **Never mention ARC or ARCtick.** Never claim "authorised service agent", OEM or genuine parts. No em dashes, no hype words ("genuinely", "honestly", "100% guaranteed", "best price"), no fake reviews or case studies.

## 5. Rules for every page (summary of CLAUDE.md sections 5 to 8, 13 to 15)

1. One page at a time, in the sheet's order. EXISTING page: update in place. NEW page: build from the template (header and footer of `freezer-repair-blacktown.html`, new head and body).
2. Unique title (60 characters or fewer), unique description (140 to 165), H1 from the sheet, 10 to 12 FAQs. FAQ schema text must equal the visible FAQ text word for word.
3. Schema on every page: WebPage (or AboutPage), HVACBusiness (site-wide node, no telephone, address, geo or rating), Service with the AUD 69 offer ("from $69"), BreadcrumbList, FAQPage. Never Product or ItemPage.
4. Sections: warning signs, what we fix, faults table, quick checks, food safety (fridge 3 to 5 degrees C, freezer -18; over 5 degrees C under 2 hours ok, 2 to 4 hours use now, over 4 hours throw out; NSW Food Authority), repair or replace and cost (from $69, no invented prices), 6-step process, areas, why choose us, FAQs, CTA with a "Related" line.
5. Add to `.htaccess` (CRLF), `sitemap-static.xml` (never edit or create a static `sitemap.xml`), Services dropdown and footer on every page, and repoint footer links that pointed to `#services` or `#brands`.
6. Canonical URLs: pages at `/slug/` with trailing slash; blog posts at `/blog/slug` without one.
7. Public PHP pages must define `SKIP_SESSION` before requiring `admin/config.php`.
8. Flag every assumption for the owner at the end of the reply; never put `[CONFIRM]` placeholders in published pages.

## 6. Workflow that works (how to ship)

1. `git fetch origin`. Designated branch is `claude/modest-euler-mp89t1`. If its last PR is merged, `git checkout -B claude/modest-euler-mp89t1 origin/Main`; if the PR is still open, stack new commits on the branch (only one open PR per branch is possible, so update that PR's title and body instead of creating another).
2. Build the page. The builder is `.claude/skills/new-page/build.py` (`from build import *`; `build(...)` writes the page and validates FAQ schema; `wire(slug, label, dropdown, footer)` adds the `.htaccess` rule, the sitemap entry and menu or footer links). The Claude Code skill `/new-page` describes the whole routine.
3. `python3 -I tests/seo_check.py` must pass. Check the page at 1366 px and 390 px with Playwright (no console errors; a few px of sideways scroll from the shared comparison table style is pre-existing and ignored).
4. Commit with these trailer lines: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>` and `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01QdDCEeKFAop2nZM5U61X6F`. Push with `git push --force-with-lease -u origin claude/modest-euler-mp89t1` after a reset to Main.
5. Open the PR against `Main` (GitHub MCP tool `create_pull_request`; it sometimes fails with a connection reset, just retry). PR body ends with the line `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` and the session link. Never push to `Main`. Never create a PR unless asked (the owner asks for it with "pr bana do" or the routine "next page" flow, where a PR is expected).
6. Tell the owner to merge, then check the **three green ticks** in Actions (checks, deploy, smoke-test) and the live URL.

Gotchas: do not use `pkill -f` with a pattern that matches your own shell (this killed the shell once). The sandbox proxy blocks the live site (403), so live HTTP checks must be done by the owner or the smoke-test job. The GitHub MCP connection drops often; reload tools with ToolSearch. A local Apache 2.4 test is possible (apt works) using the real `.htaccess` with a stub `admin/config.php` (sqlite).

## 10. Remaining technical notes

- Blog list shows the latest 50 posts only (no pagination); homepage blog preview and blog sidebar load by JavaScript (posts are still linked in plain HTML on `/blog/`).
- `about-us.html` uses an `AboutPage` and a plain `Organization` type for the shared business `@id`; other pages use `HVACBusiness`. Harmless.
- Sitemap `lastmod` on static pages comes from file modified time on the server.
- Hooks in `.claude/settings.json` run the SEO check after edits to root pages, `.htaccess` or `sitemap-static.xml`, and block edits to `sitemap.xml` (and ask before `admin/config.php` and `send_mail.php`). Hooks do not fire for edits made through Bash scripts, so always run `tests/seo_check.py` before a push.
- Data limits: Semrush AU volumes are directional only. Search ranking positions found by web search are unverified. Never guarantee indexing or rankings. 54 crawl requests in Search Console is normal for a one-month-old domain.

First read `.github/seo/HANDOFF_CONTEXT.md`, then `CLAUDE.md` in full, then the strategy files in `.github/seo/`. Follow the rules in the handoff file exactly: only confirmed facts, "from $69", "up to 12 months", no phone, address, reviews or ARC, unique title and description per page, schema on every page, never push to `Main`, branch then pull request, run `python3 tests/seo_check.py`. Reply to the owner in short plain English or Roman Urdu, task names in bold. Start with section 9A of the handoff file and ask the owner before anything in 9B or 9C.
